extracted.name: Strawberry and Feta Salad
extracted.description: This strawberry feta salad with romaine, toasted almonds, and a sweet-tangy vinaigrette dressing is a delicious way to enjoy summer strawberries!
instruction_lines: Place almonds in a skillet over medium-high heat; cook, stirring frequently, until lightly toasted. Remove from heat; set aside.
To make the dressing: whisk garlic, honey, Dijon mustard, raspberry vinegar, balsamic vinegar, brown sugar, and vegetable oil together until well combined.
Place toasted almonds, romaine lettuce, strawberries, and feta cheese in a salad bowl; add dressing and toss to coat.
